name: Boiler steam drum and mud drum
description: In drum-type water-tube boilers the upper steam drum is the point of steam/water separation and feedwater introduction, while the lower mud drum collects sediment; downcomers carry cooler dense water to the lower drum and risers return the heated mixture. Drum temperature stratification during cycling drives humping and connection stress, so drum design and circulation are central to load-change capability.

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: water-tube boilers with steam drums handle steam up to 160 bar

B&W: thermal shock differentials reduced from 200-400 F to below 100 F (56 C) in improved designs
